import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Solution {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String input = sc.nextLine().trim();

        int n = input.length();
        int ans = 0;
        int count = 1;
        for(int i= 0;i<n-1;i++){
            if(input.charAt(i) == input.charAt(i+1)){
                count++;
            }
            else{
                if(count%2 == 0)ans++;

                count= 1;
            }
        }
        if(count%2 == 0)ans++;

        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
</perturbed_code_1>
